title: Detailed rubber duck
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#FFE14D'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#F5B81E'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='head' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#FFF06B'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#FFD02E'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='beak' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#FF9B33'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#E86A17'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='wing' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#F7C933'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#DD9A18'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- water ripples -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='44' ry='7' fill='#2E6FC4'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='38' ry='6' fill='#3E8BE6'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='32' ry='5' fill='#5AA8F0'/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M14 68 Q6 58 16 56 Q24 57 26 64 Z' fill='#DD9A18'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <path d='M16 66 Q18 50 38 44 L62 44 Q82 50 84 66 Q84 82 50 84 Q16 82 16 66 Z' fill='url(#body)'/>

  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='72' rx='22' ry='10' fill='#FFED9B' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- wing -->
  <path d='M30 58 Q26 70 38 78 Q54 82 58 74 Q50 66 44 60 Z' fill='url(#wing)'/>
  <path d='M34 62 Q33 70 41 75' stroke='#C98A12' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 60 Q40 69 47 74' stroke='#C98A12' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M46 59 Q47 67 53 71' stroke='#C98A12' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='56' cy='34' r='20' fill='url(#head)'/>

  <!-- cheek -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='38' rx='5' ry='3.6' fill='#FFB0A0' opacity='0.75'/>

  <!-- beak upper -->
  <path d='M74 33 Q86 33 87 38 Q86 41 76 40 Z' fill='url(#beak)'/>
  <!-- beak lower -->
  <path d='M75 41 Q85 42 83 45 Q77 47 73 43 Z' fill='#C95A10'/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='36' r='1.1' fill='#B04E0C'/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='30' rx='4.4' ry='5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='63.2' cy='30.5' r='2.6' fill='#22160A'/>
  <circle cx='64.2' cy='29.3' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- eyebrow-ish brow -->
  <path d='M58 24 Q62 22 66 24' stroke='#D9A21C' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- feather tuft -->
  <path d='M46 16 Q50 8 54 15 Q57 9 62 16' stroke='#F0B81C' stroke-width='2.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
